profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary:
Seasoned software vet looking to rid the world of pain points (as related to software development). 

I have over 15 years of experience in software development spanning over a variety of domains ranging from aerospace to mobile app development to most recently, oil/gas. Specialties include:

•	Languages: Java, C/C++, Python, XML, HTML
•	Technologies: Eclipse RCP, OSGi, JMS, RMI, MPI
•	Tools: Git, SVN, Ant, Maven, Gradle, Bamboo, Crucible, Fisheye, JProfiler, YourKit Java Profiler
•	Testing Tools: Clover, Emma, Cobertura, findbugs, JUnit
•       Methodologies: Design patterns, Software architectural styles, Domain driven design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Developer, I developed and maintained a seismic processing workflow system known as Reveal using Java and Eclipse RCP. I designed and tested software enhancements, and ensured code quality through reviews and testing. I utilized SWT for user interface development, collaborated with support teams via Zendesk, and authored documentation. I drove process improvements, employed object-oriented design and design patterns, managed source code with GitHub, and tracked issues with JIRA. Additionally, I provided technical guidance to junior team members, effectively communicated technical information to clients, and efficiently managed user requests.

Major milestones include:

- Graph-Based Automated Seismic Workflow Sub-System: Designed and implemented a sophisticated graph-based, automated seismic workflow sub-system in Reveal. This system supports advanced features like nesting and looping operations, known as “Job Chaining,” which significantly enhances the efficiency and flexibility of seismic data processing workflows.

- Switchover from Subversion to Git: Architected the transition of our software group’s version control system from Subversion to Git. This involved setting up and integrating GitHub actions for continuous integration and deployment, implementing JIRA for issue tracking, and integrating Zendesk for customer support. This switchover streamlined our development processes, improved collaboration, and enhanced overall productivity.

- Multi-Component Dataset Viewer: Implemented a highly performant multi-component dataset viewer in Reveal. This viewer allows users to efficiently visualize and interact with complex datasets, improving data analysis capabilities and user experience.

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Actively worked with clients to customize Energy Trading and Risk Management solutions that surpassed customer expectations. The focus for these efforts resided in back office reporting (Confirms/Invoices) and accounting via optimizing SQL queries/tables and OpenJVS scripting within the Endur platform.


Actively collaborated with client requirements to implement custom solutions within the Endur platform .

positions.title: Sr. Geophysical Programmer
positions.description:
After transitioning to a Senior Software Developer role at ConocoPhillips, I began focusing more on velocity modeling and imaging development/enhancement. I worked with my team and other model engineers to design and engineer key toolsets for highly-performant velocity-model building workflows. 

I leveraged a combination of design patterns coupled with an assortment of technologies such as Java, MPI and Python to produce industry leading velocity modeling tools.

positions.title: Geophysical Programmer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of talented senior developers and engineers to architect a geoscience framework capable of integrating individual legacy geoscience applications into a single and more maintainable platform. Additionally, implemented a custom continuous integration solution for the development team.

• Enabled quicker integration of pre-existing Matlab code into newer Java-based frameworks by leveraging Matlab’s Builder JA library, Java RMI and a multi-threading pipeline pattern to access the Matlab code directly from Java 

• I worked with a very talented software engineering team to successfully architect a geoscience framework called GeoCraft that enabled senior and staff geoscientists to easily implement their algorithms as tools without having to be software engineers and we did it using Eclipse RCP with OSGi declarative services.

• In an effort to promote the principles of continuous integration, I implemented a unique automated build system for an Eclipse based Rich Client Platform application using Eclipse PDE integrated with Ant, Subversion, JUnit, Trac, Atlassian Bamboo and Clover. We also used Atlassian Crucible/Fisheye to conduct quick code reviews.

• We created substantial savings in code maintainability and enhanced functionality by working on a common platform for hosting diverse geoscience applications that leveraged data from a variety of data sources with varying formats.

positions.title: Real-Time Software Engineer
positions.description: Working in Seattle, our group was dealing with a maintenance nightmare in which the legacy hardware we were using for portions of the F-22 pilot training system were quickly becoming inadequate. So, in an attempt to steer the project in a more maintainable direction, I was charged with porting a great deal of IRIX arena based code written in ADA over to a distributed Linux-based system using C++ and sockets. By working with my team in an Agile way, we consistently completed all of our major milestones well ahead of schedule and, consequently, achieved an “Exceeding Expectations” performance rating for the entirety of my career at Boeing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: During my time at Lockheed Martin, I did extensive ELINT related software development work using C++, STL algorithms and object-oriented design patterns to increase the maintainability of the software codebase and, consequently, reduce its associated maintenance costs. Additionally, my role required design development using tools such as UML, flowcharts and highly structured peer reviews. I also helped manage team deliveries into the product baseline using a proprietary software management tool. Ultimately, my first professional experience after graduating from the University of Texas at Austin gave me invaluable practical experience in all stages of the software development lifecycle.

projects.title: Angry Pigs
projects.description: Game development using Maya and Sculptris to create game object models and implementing the game using the Unity platform, complete with physics. It was a first person shooter version spin on the popular Angry Birds game, where the pigs were sling-shotted at the birds placed randomly in the environment. Internally, it was implemented with Unity using C# and JavaScript to handle game object logic.

projects.title: Windows Phone Dressage App
projects.description:
As part of my Master’s Capstone project, we helped implement a Windows Phone app that assisted with planning a series of moves for the sport, Horse Dressage. It involved enhancing the user-interface using the Windows Phone emulator environment within Visual Studio Express and C# to implement the logic.

Basically, it is an application that allows someone to watch animated dressage movements performed by a horse in a simulated dressage test.  These are difficult movements, thus riders need much time and effort to train the horse. This Windows Phone Dressage App makes the rider’s job easier by giving them a handy tool to view the animated version of any dressage test with convenience and ease.
